title: Phobia
lines: The overall strength of the Phobia creates great length with a powerful ball motion.
The 500/1000 Abralon finish is polished with Powerhouse Factory Finish Polish to store energy for the back end.
Our NEW Phobia core brings a powerful symmetric option to complement the legendary Gas Mask core.
REACTION Strong Mid-Lane with Continuous Backend
FACTORY FINISH 500/1000 Abralon® Polished w/ Powerhouse™ Factory Finish Polish
BEST LANE CONDITION Medium to Heavy Oil
